# Tools the release build job installs (.github/workflows/release.yml), pinned
# with hashes: `pip install --require-hashes` refuses anything else, so a
# compromised or re-uploaded release of build or uv cannot reach the job that
# produces the files PyPI publishes. Dependabot (pip, /.github) proposes updates.
# uv lists only the manylinux x86_64 wheel: the job runs on ubuntu-latest (x64).
